Name: Nocturnal Dash
Author: sooualuna
Description:
[b]Nocturne Dash[/b] adds a fast, responsive directional dash to Stardew Valley, inspired by the stylish movement of classic gothic metroidvanias such as [i]Castlevania: Symphony of the Night[/i].
Dash across the world while leaving behind a trail of spectral afterimages made from your Farmer's actual appearance and animation frames.
The dash integrates with Stardew Valley's collision system, so it won't simply phase through walls and solid obstacles. It's designed to feel like a natural extension of the game's movement — especially during combat and exploration.
Features
[list]
[*][b]Four-directional dash[/b] — dash up, down, left or right.[/*]
[*][b]Spectral afterimages[/b] — previous animation frames of your Farmer remain briefly behind you during the dash.[/*]
[*][b]Full Farmer rendering[/b] — afterimages use your character's actual appearance instead of a generic sprite.[/*]
[*][b]Collision-aware movement[/b] — walls, buildings and solid obstacles stop your dash.[/*]
[*][b]Anti-tunneling collision[/b] — movement is checked in small steps, preventing high-speed dashes from skipping through thin obstacles.[/*]
[*][b]Keyboard & controller support.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Fully configurable dash binding.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Vanilla input suppression[/b] — the button assigned to dash can be prevented from also triggering its normal Stardew action.[/*]
[*]Configurable [b]dash speed, duration and cooldown[/b].[/*]
[*]Configurable [b]afterimage amount, opacity and persistence[/b].[/*]
[*]Optional [b]dash sound and visual effects[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu support.[/b][/*]
[/list]Requirements
[b]SMAPI[/b] — Required
[b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] — Optional, but highly recommended.
Installation
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download and extract [b]NocturneDash[/b].[/*]
[*]Place the
[code]NocturneDash[/code]folder inside
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]If you're using Generic Mod Config Menu, open the mod settings to configure your dash.[/*]
[/list]Controller Support
Nocturne Dash supports controller bindings through SMAPI. You can assign the dash to whichever button or combination works best with your control scheme.
If your chosen button normally performs another Stardew Valley action, [b]vanilla input suppression[/b] can prevent that action from triggering when you dash.
Configuration
You can customize the dash to make it subtle or extremely fast. Available settings include dash key, speed, duration, cooldown, afterimage frequency, lifetime, opacity, amount, sound and visual effects.
Compatibility
Nocturne Dash doesn't replace the Farmer sprite and doesn't include custom character sprites. Its afterimages are rendered from your Farmer, allowing the effect to follow your character's appearance.
The dash uses Stardew Valley's collision system instead of simply teleporting the player through the map.
Inspiration
Nocturne Dash was heavily inspired by the fast, stylish movement and afterimage effects of [i]Castlevania: Symphony of the Night[/i].
[b]No assets, sprites, sounds or code from Castlevania are included.[/b]
